turns.line: Green like what, exactly?

turns.line: Green like a salad. It's a work lunch.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: And everyone else ordered burgers, right?

blocks.through_line_state: loose leaves coming down one at a time

CLOSE on Pipes' eyes following one leaf down

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: We didn't want the salad. She knows.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: She said it out loud. Confidently.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: In front of people. That's the problem.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There's dressing. On the side.

blocks.through_line_state: the leaves land and one of them talks

CLOSE, low angle: two bright eyes opening on one leaf

CLOSE on the eyes: the leaf optimistic, Gut hollow

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Sir. There's nothing to you.

turns.speaker: salad
turns.line: Hey! Lots of fiber down here!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: I asked for calories, not fiber.

turns.speaker: salad
turns.line: Kale, arugula, three chickpeas, and hope!

shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ watching the monitor with mild guilt

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ. We're going to be hungry.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: She wanted to seem like this.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Seem like what, exactly, HQ?

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: A person who orders salad. Publicly.

turns.line: Yuvi. Is there anything else coming?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: So that's it? That was lunch?

turns.speaker: yuvi

turns.line: Three o'clock. She's at the machine.
